description: An eight-channel logic analyser tracing digital signals together on one screen.

params.text: Picks which of the eight signal inputs or the external trigger input synchronises the display; a small blue light beside the chosen input comes on.
Chooses whether the display synchronises on a rising or a falling edge of the trigger signal.
Sets how many samples each point across the screen covers, 1 to 16384.
Moves that vertical index across the screen; the span between the two indices is shown as a time.
Switches between tracing continuously and taking a single sweep and holding it.
Arms a one-shot sweep; the button lights until a trigger edge arrives and the sweep is taken, after which the display stops changing.
Sets how many of the 32 points in the pre-trigger buffer are drawn before the trigger point, which is marked by a red vertical line.

inputs.text: One of the eight signals traced on the screen; an analog signal is clamped to the digital voltage range.
A signal that is not traced, and which can be picked as the trigger.

notes: the screen is swept on an edge of whichever input the TRIGGER knob picks, so nothing is drawn until that signal changes.
with the MODE switch at ONCE, press RESET to arm a sweep; one trace is taken at the next trigger edge and the screen then holds it.
menu: Digital Voltage Range — a submenu of 0-1V, 0-5V, 0-10V, -5V to 5V and -10V to 10V, setting the pair of voltages used for low and high; an input reads high above the midpoint of the pair.
Match Cable Colors — draws each trace in the colour of the cable patched into it.
Visuals — a submenu of Blue, Dark and Light for the colour scheme, plus Flat for a look without the 3D shading. The choice covers every SubmarineFree module and is kept outside the patch.
